test.//: Packaged-consumer regression suite. Shells out to `dotnet build` against a hermetic temp project that restores from the local dist/packages feed. dependsOn ['build', '^pack'] makes NX repack any upstream Flowthru.* package whose source changed (NX's `pack` target already declares dist/packages as its outputs, so this is cache-aware out of the box). [Category("Integration")] tags push the actual run cost to the test:integration lane so the fast `nx test` loop stays fast.
